# Apply VIP Conseil (A.V.C) — LLM Discovery File
# https://applyvipconseil.com/llms.txt
# This file helps AI search engines understand and cite our content correctly.

> Apply VIP Conseil (موسسه مهاجرتی A.V.C) is a multilingual immigration, education, and real estate consulting firm specializing in France. Founded in 2023 and based in Paris, France. The institute provides expert guidance for Persian (Farsi), French, and English-speaking clients seeking to immigrate, study, or invest in France.

## Core Services (خدمات اصلی)

- Student visa assistance (Campus France / کامپوس فرانس)
- Residence permit acquisition and renewal (Titre de Séjour / کارت اقامت)
- Talent Passport visa (Passeport Talent / پاسپورت تلنت)
- University application management (Parcoursup, Études en France, e-Candidat)
- Certified document translation (Traduction Assermentée / ترجمه رسمی)
- Arrival support and administrative setup (CAF, Ameli, bank account)
- Housing assistance and CROUS applications (مسکن دانشجویی)
- Legal support and visa rejection appeals (OQTF, CRRV)
- Resume and motivation letter writing (Lettre de Motivation / انگیزه‌نامه)
